title: docs: add missing supporters to README
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- The website's Community page lists 21 supporters; the README only had 11.
- Adds the 10 missing ones (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Fireworks AI, Replicate, RunPod, OVHcloud, Lambda Labs, ElevenLabs, AssemblyAI, Alibaba Cloud) in the same order and style as `pollinations.ai/src/copy/content/community.ts`.
- All 21 URLs verified reachable.

gist.headline: The thank-you garden grew
gist.blurb: Ten missing supporters have been added to the README's thank-you patch. The credits now match the Community page, because appreciation should not require a scavenger hunt.
gist.summary: Updated README.md with 10 supporters—OpenAI, OpenRouter, Fireworks AI, Replicate, RunPod, OVHcloud, Lambda Labs, ElevenLabs, AssemblyAI, and Alibaba Cloud—so its full 21-supporter list matches the Community page.
gist.impact: README visitors now see the same complete, verified supporter roster as the website's Community page.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy community garden of 21 labeled flower plaques representing supporters, with Polli carefully adding the final ten plaques to match a nearby Community-page noticeboard; vines and code-plants connect the garden and retro terminal.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny gardener hat, adding the last flower plaques to a warm community thank-you garden beside a retro monitor showing a complete list of 21 supporters. Lime green (#ecf874) is prominent among pastel flowers, code-plants, and soft warm cream gradients; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
